why: Both analyses land on nearly the same credit-guarantee hedgehog, the same stop-doing items (EPS goal and pay, portfolio growth on thin capital, operating earnings) and all four key brutal facts, with assumptions flagged and no invented figures. Analysis 2 edges ahead with a tighter verdict, an explicit 'Stage 2 with Stage 3 signals' read, and a pointed flag that 16 years of smooth earnings warrants a look at amortization and hedge accounting, though Analysis 1 alone anticipates reaching down the credit curve.
